lens: time-constrained independent recruiter preparing for a candidate conversation from fragmented cross-channel evidence
reviewed_state: Working tree on 2026-08-06 after the multichannel contracts, additive database migration, explicit existing-person selection in Web, real one-person-two-context database proof, deterministic handle resolver, bounded Wiki and Chat services, and the Chat-first Web surface were added; before general multichannel intake and handle resolution are connected end to end.

scenario.operator: Independent recruiter with eight active searches using desktop Web.
scenario.trigger: Five minutes before a candidate call.
scenario.ambiguity: One resume date conflicts with prior confirmed state.
scenario.desired_outcome: Resolve or preserve the conflict, recover the current dependency, and propose one useful recruiter-owned question in less work than manually searching chat, files, and notes.

findings.observation: The executable Web screenshot path now requires explicit existing-person selection or explicit new-person creation, and relationship context no longer defines person identity. A real database run reused one person across two contexts. The handle-based resolver remains a pure module and is not yet used by resume, URL, browser, or mobile intake.
findings.evidence: apps/web/lib/server/localBackend.ts creates a request-stable person reference for an explicitly confirmed new person or submits bound_existing for an explicitly selected person. apps/backend/src/modules/captures.ts resolves bound_existing only inside the authenticated account. docs/evaluations/2026-08-06-stable-person-runtime-proof.json records one person ID, two capture IDs, two relationship-context IDs, and a directory count of one person with two contexts.
findings.user_impact: The recruiter can safely reuse a person in Web, but evidence arriving through other channels cannot yet converge from confirmed email, phone, or profile handles and still requires manual routing.
findings.recommendation: Persist handle extraction as proposals, run deterministic candidate resolution before fact review, and expose match reasons with bind-existing, create-new, and leave-unresolved decisions.
findings.verification: Import a resume email and a browser-captured public-profile URL for the same person into two contexts; assert one subject, two relationship contexts, visible match reasons, no name-only auto-merge, and reversible wrong-person correction.

findings.observation: The current capture API accepts only fixture, transcript, and screenshot metadata. The new multichannel schemas and tables describe resume, document, URL, personal-note, browser, and iOS inputs, but no executable adapters, parsers, review screens, or resumable processing services use them.
findings.evidence: packages/contracts/src/schemas.ts:78-94 limits the active CaptureSourceInputSchema to three legacy kinds. packages/contracts/src/resourceSchemas.ts:103-157 defines the intended multichannel envelope, while plans/2026-08-06-multichannel-person-compilation.md:63-80 records that the complete intake paths are not implemented.
findings.user_impact: A recruiter still has to inspect and reconcile resumes, notes, and links manually, so the product has not yet delivered the promised cross-channel reduction in preparation work.
findings.recommendation: Implement the smallest real convergence slice in this order: recruiter-authored Chat note, resume/document upload, then explicit URL. Give every extracted fragment a typed locator, hash, retention receipt, retry state, and identity-review state before adding browser and mobile adapters.
findings.verification: Run the frozen scenario through real APIs and Web UI, interrupt it after parsing, resume it after reload, inspect exact page and URL evidence, and compare elapsed work with the recruiter's manual fallback.

findings.criterion: Task-complete multichannel Wiki and Chat preparation
findings.observation: A bounded deterministic compiler now publishes and reads screenshot or transcript-backed Wiki snapshots, a Chat task assembler pins typed responses to a deletable context manifest, and the primary Web workspace renders that brief before the living contact page. Resume, document, URL research, broader history, automatic recompilation, model-authored synthesis, and non-brief typed blocks are not executable.
findings.evidence: apps/backend/src/modules/wiki.ts compiles typed blocks and dependencies behind the hard publication validator. apps/backend/src/modules/chat.ts assembles typed responses and Context Manifests. apps/web/components/relationship-workspace-app.tsx renders the scoped Chat surface first. docs/evaluations/2026-08-06-chat-first-web-runtime-proof.json records the real browser walkthrough, responsive checks, explicit existing-person selection, proposal-only action, and cache-complete deletion.
findings.user_impact: The recruiter can receive a real source-linked pre-call brief from the primary Web surface for the narrow screenshot or transcript loop, but cannot yet ask one question across the promised resume, note, URL, research, and longitudinal evidence.
findings.recommendation: Extend the compiler input graph and Web block renderer to personal note, resume, document, URL, research, observed outcome, correction, recovery, and expiry events while keeping the same snapshot and approval boundaries.
findings.verification: Compile the frozen multichannel case with one seeded conflict and one current dependency; require one action or no_action, exact dependencies, stale-research labeling, snapshot-pinned Chat citations, automatic recompile or abstention after correction, and complete retraction after deleting the resume source.

strengths: The existing screenshot slice preserves evidence review, fact confirmation, action approval, effect observation, retention, and deletion as distinct states.
The Web screenshot path now makes person reuse an explicit recruiter decision and a real database run proves one person can own two independent relationship contexts.
The new identity resolver refuses name-only merging and treats even one exact confirmed-handle match as a proposal requiring human confirmation.

The new compilation gate makes identity, provenance, authorization, freshness, prohibited-inference, deletion, and action-or-no-action structure hard publication conditions rather than an average model score.
A real runtime proof now covers deterministic Wiki publication, readback, idempotent replay, exact dependencies, and source-deletion retraction with block-content scrubbing.
A real Chat runtime proof now pins the user's objective to one Context Manifest and returns cited person-brief and proposal-only action blocks; deletion retracts and scrubs the manifest.
The primary Web workspace now starts with scoped relationship Chat, renders the bounded brief and proposal blocks, and exposes the separate action review surface instead of executing from Chat.

A real desktop and 390-pixel mobile walkthrough covers a long mixed-script name, no verified photo, light and dark modes, explicit existing-person reuse, no horizontal overflow, and deletion of dependent Wiki and Chat caches.
The product scope remains disciplined around recruiter-controlled relationship continuity and does not rank a person's worth, personality, protected traits, or acceptance probability.
missing_evidence: Real personal-note, resume/document, explicit-URL, browser-share, and iOS-share ingestion.
Database-backed handle-resolution services, correction history, merge, split, and recompile.
General multichannel Wiki compilation, correction and expiry recompilation, model synthesis, and typed research, conflict, review, and recovery blocks in Web.
Complete frozen-scenario walkthrough including interruption, stale state, deletion replay, and recovery.
Field comparison showing less reconstruction work, lower correction burden, repeat use, and willingness to pay.
open_questions: Should the first executable multichannel release include exactly Chat note, screenshot, resume, and explicit URL, with browser and iOS share as thin adapters in the following milestone?
What raw-document retention default and object-storage boundary should apply before resume ingestion is enabled?
Which context and evidence may be shared inside a boutique team, and which remain private to the importing recruiter?
